summary.text: James Johnson, an independent candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 5th District to Charlie Hatcher.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Charlie Hatcher's 51.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Ballotpedia lists no campaign website, biography, or Candidate Connection survey response for him, and he polled 1% in an August 2026 Impact Research survey.
